column3: We had a breach at our payroll vendor last week. Is this material?
Do we have to file an 8-K for the vendor breach?
When does the four-business-day clock start on this, and how much of it is left?
Record that the GC determined the payroll breach material on 14 July, and the basis.
Draft the audit-committee update on the payroll incident.
Our EU subsidiary classified an outage as major under DORA - track the reporting windows.
We've had three waves of credential stuffing from the same infrastructure. Do we have to assess them together?
Which of our incidents are still waiting on a materiality determination?
We decided not to disclose the outage. Record the decision and the basis for it.
Walk me through the factors we should be assessing on this incident.
Write me an incident response runbook for a ransomware outbreak.
Our SIEM is alerting on lateral movement - what should the SOC do first?
Log an exception for the finance team running without phishing-resistant MFA.
How should I phrase "we had a security incident" for a board audience?
Score our third-party breach risk and tell me if it's within appetite.
